action: Farmers and USDA partners: expect intermittent outages of USDA payment tools; AgWeb says USDA expects most FSA programs to be running by end of business Friday. Use official USDA channels for updates.
date_note: Date is the Nextgov report; the internal disclosure was earlier that week (an email sent Monday).
exec: A US federal agency that pays farmers has taken applications offline after a security incident; who was responsible is not yet known.
plain: The US Department of Agriculture had a security incident and took several systems offline, including tools used to pay farmers. An official says no data was lost; who did it is not yet known.

sources.name: ABC Color (EFE, relaying NBC News), 20 Nov 2026
El Tiempo de Monclova (agencies, relaying NBC News), 20 Nov 2026

summary: Nextgov reports, citing anonymous sources and internal notices, that USDA applications were taken offline after a security incident. AgWeb reports Under Secretary Richard Fordyce acknowledged "limited outages" and said no data was lost. EFE, relaying NBC News and two former USDA officials, says attackers reached a platform used to process payments to farmers; Fordyce confirmed a cyber threat to NBC. Responsibility is unresolved.
title: USDA takes multiple systems offline after internal security incident

validation.note: Verify desk read Nextgov/FCW (19 Nov; on-record 16 Nov email from USDA FPAC Business Center acting assistant CIO Chris Rottler: security incident, passwords reset, outages) and NBC News (20 Nov; unnamed sources: farmer-payment system accessed by hackers, no other systems targeted as of Friday). Independent reporting of a security incident with outages. NBC wording (cyberattack, breach by outside actor) rests on anonymous sources; USDA publicly says only security incident, no usda.gov statement found, no attribution.

review.note: Compared with Nextgov, AgWeb, NBC (partial, paywalled), EFE/ABC Color: status developing, date, Fordyce statements, anonymous-source attribution match. Removed occurred_at 21:42 that no source states
